subject.title: [Feature]: Expose sessionKey/runId to outbound message hook for deterministic verification

question: Should outbound pre-send plugin hooks expose same-turn transcript/tool-call/result evidence, and what redaction, permission, and field-shape contract should own that access?
rationale: The remaining work changes a public Plugin SDK API and may expose sensitive session/tool data before delivery, so automation cannot safely choose the evidence scope or security boundary.

options.title: Add bounded evidence contract
options.body: Expose run identity plus capped, redacted same-turn verification evidence on the chosen pre-send hook with documented permission semantics.

options.title: Land runId first
options.body: Thread outbound runId and message identity now, while deferring transcript/tool-result evidence to a separate Plugin SDK design.

options.title: Defer evidence access
options.body: Keep current hook surfaces advisory and close or pause the evidence request if maintainers decide plugins should not inspect same-turn tool evidence before send.

recommendation.title: Add bounded evidence contract
recommendation.body: Expose run identity plus capped, redacted same-turn verification evidence on the chosen pre-send hook with documented permission semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: This person is tied to the prior review and merged the closest hook-context PRs, making them the best available owner for the product/security boundary choice.
